title: Mantell's plane disintegrated by magnetism

tellings.quote: Didn't say it had been blown out of the air and then crashed and it said it disintegrated.

plain: The plane of a pilot named Thomas Mantell, who went down near Fort Knox, Kentucky, in 1948, did not blow up and crash but "disintegrated", according to Silas Newton, a man whose recorded words are heard in the episode, who blames magnetism. Newton is passing on what he says the account of the crash stated. If true, it would mean the plane was torn apart by some unknown force.
